author: bigbear380
body:
Map download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/u677irx0rkrkjzn/AACPscmF8XrAAFx72o9JJJa8a
map pictures: http://bigbear380.imgur.com

Most of the maps I saw at the walls in the server seemed complicated lots of movement and lots of things to do to get ready in only 10 minutes, it's also pressure on some players (like me), So I made a map thats really simple and I extended its time to 12 minutes.

The map is a basic scout camp that has lots of hidden chests (although im not good at hiding stuff),and most of the stuff in the chests are raw materials used to craft whatever you think of, it also tests your crafting and minecraft gaming abilities and skills.

The map is made for 4 players, so you have to use your material wisely and play as a team in order to win, and there is no lava or fire or potions that can actually teamkill so you can feel safe and focus on getting ready using these 12 minutes.

At the middle, there is a tall mountain/tower for players that like to climb and there is a nice prize on top of it for good climbers including diamond blocks, plus there is a couple of iron/gold blocks in the mountain to encourage players to rush to the middle at the drop of the walls

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: I like the idea of making something simple, few things to keep in mind. No one is going to climb up the middle wall, they will build up and over to the wall ( or use ender pearls )... then down to get the goodies in the middle.The map is built just fine - if that's your vision more power to you, but here are some things that most likely will stop it from getting accepted.I counted almost 80 exp potions and over 30 diamonds per side + strength on each side add that to the Notch apples in the middle and you get a few players that will be very OP and everyone else that will have nothing especially because you are allowing lvl 30 enchants ( or 5 lvl 17 enchants )  the guy that gets the diamonds , strength and enchants ( or/and op axe ) is going to be hard to stop - just think about when the map has only 1 player on one side and 2-3 on other teams. the 2-3 team people don't have a chance - really. Also, the map allows for much player stacking so watch out...The bottom line - this map will be very fast, players will be 1 hit killed many times and that could make it tough to play ( other than just skybasing ). Other than that I like the ideas , and I feel your heart was into making it a super fun game, but I fear it could meet troubled waters as anyone that gets 10 diamonds or more with lvl 17 enchants and makes it to the middle will be unstoppable )
